artifact_groups.rationale: Parts inventory: eleven geometric specimens laid out on workbench. Clipboard tracks what's available — bricolage begins with knowing your materials.
Affordance discovery: same primitives recast as functional parts — cylinder as axle or column, plane as seat or wall, sphere as hub or joint. Parts reveal what they can do.
Arrays as structural probes: linear, radial, grid, and stack arrangements test how repetition transforms single parts into spatial systems.
Constraint literacy: pass/fail pairs for gravity, balance, and triangulation. What pushes back teaches what holds together — structure emerges from what fails.
First assembly challenge: chair from inventory parts. Builder tool, parts palette, and assembled reference — construction without blueprint, guided by constraint satisfaction.
Sculpture as balance negotiation: counterweight and tension demos teach forces, two balanced sculptures show solutions, builder lets players compose their own equilibrium.
Geodesic dome as capstone: icosahedron base, strut inventory, subdivision demo, and dome builder synthesize all prior skills — parts, affordances, constraints, assembly — into Fuller's tensegrity.
